case_name: Rights of citizenship of certain persons who have migrated to India from Pakistan
facts: A person who has migrated to the territory of India from the territory now included in Pakistan
He or either of his parents or any of his grand-parents was born in India as defined in the Government of India Act, 1935 (as originally enacted)
The person has been ordinarily resident in the territory of India since the date of his migration
holding: A person who has migrated to the territory of India from the territory now included in Pakistan shall be deemed to be a citizen of India at the commencement of this Constitution
Provided that no person shall be so registered unless he has been resident in the territory of India for at least six months immediately preceding the date of his application
